caption: The drawing depicts a square textile with a grid pattern composed of small squares, each containing distinct floral or geometric motifs. The motifs include various arrangements of flowers, leaves, wreaths, potted plants, and baskets, along with birds and cornucopia. The dominant colors within the patterned area are red, green, and pink, with accents of yellow, all set against a beige or off-white background. The border of the textile features a continuous leafy vine with small red and pink flowers, enclosing the central grid. The composition is symmetrical, with each square and the border clearly defined, and the overall design is organized and repetitive. The texture and design indicate the appearance of embroidery or needlework.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
